name: push and pop preserves min-heap order
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(3)
h.push(1)
h.push(2)
assert h.pop() == 1
assert h.pop() == 2
assert h.pop() == 3

name: multiple interleaved pushes and pops
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(5)
h.push(3)
assert h.peek() == 3
h.push(4)
assert h.pop() == 3
assert h.pop() == 4
assert h.pop() == 5

name: push in sorted order — pop yields sorted sequence
code:
h = MinHeap()
for i in range(1, 11):
    h.push(i)
assert [h.pop() for _ in range(10)] == list(range(1, 11))

name: push in reverse sorted order — pop yields sorted sequence
code:
h = MinHeap()
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    h.push(i)
assert [h.pop() for _ in range(10)] == list(range(1, 11))

name: peek does not remove element
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(42)
assert h.peek() == 42
assert h.peek() == 42
assert len(h._data) == 1

name: single push and pop
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(7)
assert h.pop() == 7
assert h.is_empty()

name: pop from empty heap raises IndexError
peek from empty heap raises IndexError
is_empty reports correct status
code:
h = MinHeap()
assert h.is_empty() == True
h.push(1)
assert h.is_empty() == False
h.pop()
assert h.is_empty() == True

name: duplicate values are handled correctly
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(3)
h.push(1)
h.push(1)
h.push(3)
h.push(2)
assert [h.pop() for _ in range(5)] == [1, 1, 2, 3, 3]

name: negative and positive mix
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(-5)
h.push(0)
h.push(3)
h.push(-10)
h.push(7)
assert [h.pop() for _ in range(5)] == [-10, -5, 0, 3, 7]

name: large dataset — pop yields sorted output
code:
import random
random.seed(42)
h = MinHeap()
data = [random.randint(-1000, 1000) for _ in range(500)]
for v in data:
    h.push(v)
assert [h.pop() for _ in range(500)] == sorted(data)

name: partial push-pop interleaving
code:
h = MinHeap()
h.push(10)
h.push(20)
h.push(5)
assert h.pop() == 5
h.push(1)
h.push(15)
assert h.pop() == 1
assert h.pop() == 10
assert h.pop() == 15
assert h.pop() == 20
